cohort: The study included 81 pregnant women with preterm delivery and 92 pregnant women with full-term delivery from Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo National General Hospital between April 2020 and June 2021.
finding: Neutrophil-lymphocyte and platelet-lymphocyte ratios were not significant predictors of preterm birth, but cervical length was significantly longer in the preterm delivery group compared to the full-term delivery group (24.50 mm vs 3.15 mm).
